methodology.assignment: One PDF may be assigned to at most one XFDL. ACORD form-number and jurisdiction conflicts are hard exclusions.
methodology.confidence: High requires strong unique evidence; medium allows edition or metadata drift; review indicates a plausible but weak pair; unmatched means no candidate passed threshold.
